x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

current_min = 1 << 32
best_numerator = 1 << 32
best_denominator = 1 << 32

for denom in range(1, n + 1):
    num = max(x * denom // y - 10, 0)
    for offset in range(20):
        diff = abs(x * denom - (num + offset) * y)
        if current_min * denom > diff * best_denominator:
            current_min = diff
            best_numerator = num + offset
            best_denominator = denom
        elif current_min * denom == diff * best_denominator:
            if best_denominator > denom or (best_denominator == denom and best_numerator > num + offset):
                current_min = diff
                best_numerator = num + offset
                best_denominator = denom

print(f"{best_numerator}/{best_denominator}")
